title: TC007-post api v1 invoices invoice id reminder draft
description: Test POST /api/v1/invoices/{invoice_id}/reminder-draft generates an AI-drafted payment reminder text for invoices in sent or overdue status and returns 200 with the reminder string.
code:
import requests

BASE_URL = "http://localhost:8096"
TIMEOUT = 30


def test_post_api_v1_invoices_invoice_id_reminder_draft():
    # First create an invoice with status 'sent' or 'overdue'
    # Since the API schema in PRD does not specify status input on creation,
    # we create the invoice then update its status to 'sent'
    invoice_data = {
        "client_name": "Test Client TC007",
        "client_email": "testclient@example.com",
        "invoice_number": "INV-1007",
        "issue_date": "2026-06-01",
        "amount": 100.0,
        "due_date": "2026-06-30"
    }

    invoice_id = None
    try:
        # Create invoice
        create_resp = requests.post(
            f"{BASE_URL}/api/v1/invoices",
            json=invoice_data,
            timeout=TIMEOUT
        )
        assert create_resp.status_code == 201, f"Invoice creation failed: {create_resp.text}"
        invoice = create_resp.json()
        invoice_id = invoice.get("id")
        assert invoice_id is not None, "Missing invoice id in creation response"

        # Update invoice status to 'sent' to ensure it qualifies for reminder draft
        update_payload = {"status": "sent"}
        put_resp = requests.put(
            f"{BASE_URL}/api/v1/invoices/{invoice_id}",
            json=update_payload,
            timeout=TIMEOUT
        )
        # Possibly the endpoint accepts partial update with status?
        # If 404 or 422 or other, then fallback: skip status update and hope default is eligible
        if put_resp.status_code == 200:
            updated_invoice = put_resp.json()
            assert updated_invoice.get("id") == invoice_id, "Updated invoice id mismatch"
        else:
            # If status update failed, check current invoice status and continue anyway
            get_resp = requests.get(
                f"{BASE_URL}/api/v1/invoices/{invoice_id}",
                timeout=TIMEOUT
            )
            assert get_resp.status_code == 200, f"Failed to get invoice after creation: {get_resp.text}"
            current_invoice = get_resp.json()
            # Ideally status is 'sent' or 'overdue' - if not, test may fail or create a new invoice

        # Call reminder-draft endpoint for the invoice
        reminder_resp = requests.post(
            f"{BASE_URL}/api/v1/invoices/{invoice_id}/reminder-draft",
            timeout=TIMEOUT
        )
        assert reminder_resp.status_code == 200, f"Reminder draft request failed: {reminder_resp.text}"
        reminder_text = reminder_resp.text
        assert isinstance(reminder_text, str) and len(reminder_text.strip()) > 0, "Reminder draft response empty or invalid"

    finally:
        if invoice_id is not None:
            # Delete the created invoice to clean up
            requests.delete(
                f"{BASE_URL}/api/v1/invoices/{invoice_id}",
                timeout=TIMEOUT
            )


test_post_api_v1_invoices_invoice_id_reminder_draft()

title: TC002-post api v1 invoices create new invoice
description: Test creating a new invoice via POST /api/v1/invoices. Required fields: invoice_number (string), client_name (string), client_email (string), issue_date (date string YYYY-MM-DD), due_date (date string YYYY-MM-DD). Verify a 201 response with the created InvoiceResponse containing id, client_name, due_date, total (float), subtotal (float).
code:
import requests
from datetime import date
import uuid

BASE_URL = "http://localhost:8096"
TIMEOUT = 30

def test_post_api_v1_invoices_create_new_invoice():
    url = f"{BASE_URL}/api/v1/invoices"
    # Prepare unique invoice number to avoid conflicts
    invoice_number = f"INV-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    client_name = "Test Client"
    client_email = "testclient@example.com"
    issue_date = date.today().isoformat()
    due_date = (date.today().replace(day=28) if date.today().day <= 28 else date.today()).isoformat()

    payload = {
        "invoice_number": invoice_number,
        "client_name": client_name,
        "client_email": client_email,
        "issue_date": issue_date,
        "due_date": due_date
    }

    headers = {
        "Content-Type": "application/json"
    }

    response = None
    created_invoice_id = None

    try:
        response = requests.post(url, json=payload, headers=headers, timeout=TIMEOUT)
        assert response.status_code == 201, f"Expected status 201, got {response.status_code}"
        data = response.json()

        # Validate keys in the response
        assert "id" in data, "Missing 'id' in response"
        assert data.get("client_name") == client_name, f"Expected client_name '{client_name}', got '{data.get('client_name')}'"
        assert data.get("due_date") == due_date, f"Expected due_date '{due_date}', got '{data.get('due_date')}'"
        # total and subtotal should be floats
        assert isinstance(data.get("total"), (float, int)), "'total' is not float or int"
        assert isinstance(data.get("subtotal"), (float, int)), "'subtotal' is not float or int"

        created_invoice_id = data["id"]

    finally:
        # Cleanup if invoice was created
        if created_invoice_id:
            try:
                delete_url = f"{BASE_URL}/api/v1/invoices/{created_invoice_id}"
                del_response = requests.delete(delete_url, timeout=TIMEOUT)
                # Accept 204 No Content or 404 Not Found (if already deleted)
                assert del_response.status_code in (204, 404), f"Delete failed with status {del_response.status_code}"
            except Exception:
                pass

import requests

BASE_URL = "http://localhost:8096"
TIMEOUT = 30


def test_get_invoice_by_id():
    # Data for creating the invoice fixture
    invoice_data = {
        "invoice_number": "INV-1004",
        "client_name": "Test Client",
        "client_email": "testclient@example.com",
        "issue_date": "2024-04-25",
        "due_date": "2024-05-25"
    }

    headers = {
        "Content-Type": "application/json"
    }

    invoice_id = None

    try:
        # Create a new invoice fixture
        resp_create = requests.post(
            f"{BASE_URL}/api/v1/invoices",
            json=invoice_data,
            headers=headers,
            timeout=TIMEOUT,
        )
        assert resp_create.status_code == 201, f"Failed to create invoice: {resp_create.text}"

        assert "total" in created_invoice and isinstance(created_invoice["total"], (int, float))

        invoice_id = created_invoice["id"]

        # GET existing invoice by ID

        # Validate the response contains required fields and matches the fixture

        assert invoice.get("client_name") == invoice_data["client_name"]
        assert invoice.get("due_date") == invoice_data["due_date"]

        # GET non-existent invoice by ID (some random large id unlikely to exist)

        resp_get_404 = requests.get(
            f"{BASE_URL}/api/v1/invoices/{non_existent_id}",
            headers=headers,
            timeout=TIMEOUT,
        )
        assert resp_get_404.status_code == 404, f"Expected 404 for non-existent invoice, got {resp_get_404.status_code}"

    finally:
        # Clean up: Delete the created invoice if created
        if invoice_id:
            requests.delete(
                f"{BASE_URL}/api/v1/invoices/{invoice_id}",
                headers=headers,
                timeout=TIMEOUT,
            )

title: TC006-delete api v1 invoices delete invoice
description: Confirm DELETE /api/v1/invoices/{invoice_id} deletes an existing invoice returning 204 No Content, or 404 if not found. Invoice fixture must include required fields: invoice_number, client_name, client_email, issue_date (YYYY-MM-DD), due_date (YYYY-MM-DD). Confirm deletion via subsequent GET returning 404.
code:
import requests

BASE_URL = "http://localhost:8096"
TIMEOUT = 30

def test_delete_api_v1_invoices_delete_invoice():
    invoice_data = {
        "invoice_number": "INV-1006",
        "client_name": "Test Client Delete",
        "client_email": "clientdelete@example.com",
        "issue_date": "2024-01-01",
        "due_date": "2024-01-31"
    }
    headers = {"Content-Type": "application/json"}

    # Create invoice to delete
    try:
        create_resp = requests.post(
            f"{BASE_URL}/api/v1/invoices",
            json=invoice_data,
            headers=headers,
            timeout=TIMEOUT,
        )
        assert create_resp.status_code == 201, f"Failed to create invoice: {create_resp.text}"
        created_invoice = create_resp.json()
        invoice_id = created_invoice.get("id")
        assert invoice_id is not None, "Invoice ID missing in create response"

        # Delete the invoice
        delete_resp = requests.delete(
            f"{BASE_URL}/api/v1/invoices/{invoice_id}",
            headers=headers,
            timeout=TIMEOUT,
        )
        # Either 204 No Content on successful delete or 404 Not Found if already deleted
        assert delete_resp.status_code in (204, 404), f"Unexpected status code deleting invoice: {delete_resp.status_code}"

        if delete_resp.status_code == 204:
            # Confirm deletion with GET, expect 404
            get_resp = requests.get(
                f"{BASE_URL}/api/v1/invoices/{invoice_id}",
                headers=headers,
                timeout=TIMEOUT,
            )
            assert get_resp.status_code == 404, f"Invoice still found after deletion, status: {get_resp.status_code}"
        else:
            # If delete returned 404, confirm invoice does not exist already
            get_resp = requests.get(
                f"{BASE_URL}/api/v1/invoices/{invoice_id}",
                headers=headers,
                timeout=TIMEOUT,
            )
            assert get_resp.status_code == 404, f"Invoice unexpectedly found, status: {get_resp.status_code}"

    finally:
        # Cleanup in case delete failed, ignore errors
        if 'invoice_id' in locals():
            requests.delete(
                f"{BASE_URL}/api/v1/invoices/{invoice_id}",
                headers=headers,
                timeout=TIMEOUT,
            )
